full_text_zh:
[P1] 带领孩子感受传统文化和自然科学之美
【被世界认可的中华民族非物质文化遗产，古老农耕文明的“时间智慧”】
寒露
秋收乐曲
蕾玲 / 编著
北方妇女儿童出版社
长春

[P2] 寒露
二十四节气
山居秋暝
王维
空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。
明月松间照，清泉石上流。
竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。
随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。

[P3] 寒露
秋收乐曲
寒露的时间在每年公历10月8日~9日。
寒露时节，南岭及以北的广大地区均已进入秋季，东北地区进入深秋，西北地区则已进入或即将进入冬季。

鲜儿弯弯像卷发，
寒风冷雨它不怕，
百花凋谢它开花，
深秋时节到万家。
（打一植物）

俗话说：“吃了寒露饭，单衣汉少见。”
自从过了“寒露”这一天，
奶奶就不允许浩浩和安安随意脱衣服了。浩浩
撇了撇嘴，说：“明明
俗话还说了‘春捂秋冻，
百病难碰’，到底哪个
更有道理呢？”

[P4] 寒露三候
一候，鸿雁来宾
二候，雀入大水为蛤（gē）
三候，菊有黄华
/ 一候，鸿雁来宾
大雁在天空中排成“一”字或“人”字形的队伍，飞往南方。
/ 三候，菊有黄华
美丽的菊花已经竞相盛开，它是秋季里最美的风景。
/ 二候，雀入大水为蛤（gē）
深秋天寒，雀鸟都不见了。古人看到海边突然出现很多蛤蜊（lí），并且蛤蜊的条纹及颜色与雀鸟很相似，便以为蛤蜊是雀鸟变成的。

[P5] ／重阳节
每年的农历九月初九是重阳节，在这一天，
人们多登高远望，聚会赏菊，以求长寿。

“祝爷爷奶奶身体健康，
幸福长寿！”，

／大雁
每到秋天，北方的严寒气候不再适合大雁生存，它们便会飞往温暖的南方。飞行时，雁群会
不断发出“嘎嘎”的叫声以起到互相照顾、呼唤，
传达起飞和停歇等信号的作用。

／菊花酒
寒露与重阳节接近，此时菊花盛开，
为除秋燥，某些地区有饮菊花酒的习俗。
久而久之，这一习俗与登高一起，渐渐移
至重阳节。菊花酒是由菊花加糯米、酒曲
酿制而成，古称“长寿酒”，味道清凉香甜，
有养肝、明目、健脑、延缓衰老等功效。
full_text_en:
[P1] Guiding children to experience the beauty of traditional culture and natural science
[Recognized by the world as an intangible cultural heritage of the Chinese nation, the 'time wisdom' of ancient agrarian civilization]
Cold Dew
Autumn Harvest Ode
Compiled and written by Lei Ling
Northeast Women and Children's Publishing House
Changchun

[P2] Cold Dew
Twenty-Four Solar Terms
Autumn Evening in the Mountains
Wang Wei
After fresh rain in the empty mountains, the weather turns autumnal.
The bright moon shines through the pines, clear springs flow over stones.
The rustling bamboo signals washerwomen returning, lotus swaying marks fishermen departing.
Let spring's beauty fade at will; the noble son may stay as he pleases.

[P3] Cold Dew
Autumn Harvest Song
The time of Cold Dew is every year on October 8th to 9th.
During Cold Dew, the vast areas north of Nanling have entered autumn. The northeastern region has entered late autumn, while the northwestern region has already entered or is about to enter winter.

Its leaves curl like ringlets,
It fears neither cold wind nor rain,
When all flowers wither, it blooms,
Bringing autumn to every home.
(Guess a plant)

As the saying goes: "After Cold Dew, few men wear single-layer clothes."
Since the day of "Cold Dew",
Grandma no longer allows Haohao and Anan to take off their clothes freely. Haohao
pouted and said: "But the saying also says 'Wear warm in spring, freeze in autumn, and illness will be hard to find,' so which one makes more sense?"

[P4] Cold Dew Three Phases
First Phase: Wild Geese Arrive as Guests
Second Phase: Sparrows Enter the Great Water and Become Clams (gē)
Third Phase: Chrysanthemums Bloom in Yellow
/ First Phase: Wild Geese Arrive as Guests
Wild geese fly south in formations shaped like the Chinese characters “一” or “人”.
/ Third Phase: Chrysanthemums Bloom in Yellow
Beautiful chrysanthemums are in full bloom, the most beautiful sight of autumn.
/ Second Phase: Sparrows Enter the Great Water and Become Clams (gē)
In the deep autumn cold, sparrows disappear. Ancient people saw many clams (lí) suddenly appear by the sea, and since the patterns and colors of the clams resembled sparrows, they believed the clams were transformed sparrows.

[P5] ／Double Ninth Festival
Every year on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month is the Double Ninth Festival. On this day,
people often climb high to look far, gather to admire chrysanthemums, and pray for longevity.

"Wishing Grandpa and Grandma good health and
happiness and longevity!"

／Wild Geese
Every autumn, the harsh cold climate in the north is no longer suitable for geese to survive, so they fly to the warm south. While flying, flocks of geese
continuously make "honking" sounds to help each other, call out,
and convey signals for takeoff and landing.

／Chrysanthemum Wine
The Cold Dew and Double Ninth Festival are close in time. When chrysanthemums bloom,
people in some regions have the custom of drinking chrysanthemum wine to relieve autumn dryness.
Over time, this custom, together with mountain climbing, gradually shifted
to the Double Ninth Festival. Chrysanthemum wine is made by fermenting chrysanthemums with glutinous rice and yeast. Anciently called "Longevity Wine," it has a cool and sweet taste,
and is believed to nourish the liver, improve eyesight, strengthen the brain, and slow aging.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《寒露》的封面，展示了书名、副标题、编著者信息及出版社，配有一只坐在落叶中的兔子插图，主题围绕二十四节气中的寒露展开。
[P2] 本页描绘了寒露时节的秋日景象，一个小女孩在落叶纷飞的树下与小鸟互动，旁边有兔子和装满物品的篮子，画面左侧配以王维《山居秋暝》的诗句，营造出宁静美好的秋日氛围。
[P3] 本页介绍了寒露节气的时间和气候特点，并通过一个男孩与奶奶关于‘春捂秋冻’与‘吃了寒露饭，单衣汉少见’的对话，展现了节气对日常生活的影响，同时配有一则植物谜语。
[P4] 本页介绍了寒露节气的三候：一候鸿雁来宾，大雁南飞；二候雀入大水为蛤，古人以为雀鸟化为蛤蜊；三候菊有黄华，菊花盛开。配图分别展示了大雁、菊花和蛤蜊。
[P5] 本页介绍了重阳节的习俗、大雁南飞的自然现象以及菊花酒的制作与功效，配图分别展示了一家三代共度重阳、大雁飞翔和菊酒的场景。
